abstract: The vast majority of germ cell tumors in the thorax arise at or near the thymus. We report a case of a 41-year-old man with mature teratoma of the posterior mediastinum. He was asymptomatic and was incidentally found to have a posterior mediastinal mass. Computed tomography was helpful in suggesting a diagnosis of mature teratoma by demonstrating the presence of fat and calcification. The differential diagnosis included neurogenic tumors, liposarcoma, and extramedullary hematopoiesis.
abstract_ja: 胸部の胚細胞腫瘍の大部分は胸腺またはその近傍に発生する。今回、無症候性に後縦隔腫瘤を偶発的に指摘された41歳男性の成熟奇形腫の症例を報告する。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)では脂肪と石灰化が描出され、成熟奇形腫の診断が示唆された。鑑別診断には神経原性腫瘍、脂肪肉腫、髄外造血が含まれた。
